parsed.explanation: GE adopted ASU 2018-12 on January 1, 2023, which required retrospective adjustment of insurance liabilities back to a January 1, 2021 transition date, causing prior-period net income figures (including 2022) to be restated. This explains the difference in the 2022 net income figure between the original and later filings.
parsed.evidence_quote: On January 1, 2023, we adopted Accounting Standards Update No. 2018-12, Financial Services – Insurance (Topic 944): Targeted Improvements to the Accounting for Long-Duration Contracts. The new guidance...was adopted on a modified retrospective basis such that those balances were adjusted to conform to the new guidance at the January 1, 2021 transition date.
